description: THE REFUSAL of the delete of a role whose generated exception is in use: the platform creates 'Not DelExcRole' with the role and deletes it with it, so on its own it does not refuse (tests/jobs/delete-generated-companions.json); here an Exception Handler of the action DelExcGuard handles that exception, and the refusal names the HANDLER, which would be left without an exception. Tested coverage, phase 2.
expectError: delete: refused, IRole 'DelExcRole' is used by 1 consumer(s)

ops._why: the IRoleException 'Not DelExcRole' appears with derived false: the handler uses it
